title: SKF_CREATE_SKILL_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-create-skill prints, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_CREATE_SKILL_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when step 8 (report) finishes a brief, once per brief of a --batch run, and on stderr at every HARD HALT of steps 1 to 7. The shared emitter (skf-emit-result-envelope.py) builds each line from the payload a step stages in the brief's run folder, folds in the auto-decisions and warnings the run recorded there, derives exit_code from halt_reason, stamps timestamp, run_id and result_path, and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. The skill's SKILL.md Workflow Rules give the halt command, and references/report.md the finished run's.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when step 8 finished the brief, 'partial' when it finished a source brief whose extraction found no export (summary.warning 'zero-exports'), 'failed' at every HARD HALT, also one after step 7 promoted the package (skill_package and outputs then name what is on disk).

exit_code.description: Derived from halt_reason: null gives 0; brief-missing, brief-malformed and brief-invalid 2; forge-tier-missing, source-not-found, helper-missing and docs-unreachable 3; write-failed and staging-unreadable 4; not-skf-output, flat-layout, tier1-not-preserved, shard-xref-broken, description-angle-brackets, references-missing and active-link-blocked 5; halted-for-brief-refinement 6.

phase.description: The step slug where the HARD HALT fired: load-brief, extract, component-extraction, fetch-docs, compile, doc-sources, auto-shard, validate or generate-artifacts, or batch-mode for a --batch run whose batch could not start or go on. Null on a finished run.

halt_reason.description: Null on a finished run. The failure class of a HARD HALT, the same value as error.code and summary.halt_reason: pipelines branch on it without parsing the message.

message.description: The halt's reason, the one-line form of the message the step displayed.

phase.description: The step slug where the halt fired.

path.description: The file or folder the halt names, when it names one (a missing helper's probe path, the folder a write or the ownership check refused).

details.description: Optional halt-specific context, such as the Tier 1 sections a split moved (details.tier1_missing) or the doc URLs that failed (details.failed_urls).

error.description: Null on a finished run. The failure of a HARD HALT.

evidence_report.description: Path of {forge_version}/evidence-report.md, which holds the Auto-Decisions table.

outputs.description: The files the brief's run wrote, by kind. Empty at a HARD HALT before step 7 promoted the package; a later halt lists what is on disk.

skill_name.description: The brief's name, the skill's folder name.

version.description: The version folder the run wrote.

forge_tier.description: The tier the run compiled at, after any tier_override.

confidence_distribution.description: metadata.json confidence_distribution, as skf-render-metadata-stats.py computed it.

auto_decision_count.description: The decisions the run took without asking, as recorded in its run folder: every gate a headless run resolved by its default, and step 1's tier override in any mode. The rows of the evidence report's Auto-Decisions table; 0 when there were none.

warning.description: Set with status 'partial': a source brief's extraction found no export and the run went on.

halt_reason.description: At a HARD HALT, the halt_reason again, where the halt line carried it before the envelope had a schema.

evidence_report.description: At a HARD HALT, {forge_version}/evidence-report.md once step 7 promoted it, else null.

summary.description: On a finished run, the facts a pipeline branches on. At a HARD HALT, halt_reason and evidence_report.

skill_package.description: Absolute path of {skill_package} once step 7 promoted it; null before, and at the step 7 ownership halts (the refused folder is in error.path).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the emitter stamped from the clock.

run_id.description: The brief's run folder id, stamped by the emitter (each brief of a --batch run has its own); null for a halt before the run folder exists.

result_path.description: The per-run create-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json this envelope's call wrote in {forge_version}, beside its -latest copy, or null when it wrote none (every halt before step 7 created {forge_version}).

step.description: The step whose gate decided: load-brief, extract or component-extraction.

gate.description: The gate: tier-override, tag-choice, review-gate, zero-exports, demo-exclusion, registry-confirm, provide-or-skip-registry, or authoritative-file:<path> (one decision per authoritative file a headless run deferred).

decision.description: The action the run took, such as 'C', 'Y', 'S', 'apply' or 'deferred-headless'.

value.description: Optional: the value the decision applied, such as the tier_override or the tag chosen.

fallback.description: Optional: what the run used instead, such as the detected tier when an override was rejected.

rationale.description: Why, for example 'headless mode: no human to confirm scope or ref'.

headless_decisions.description: One entry per decision the run took without asking, recorded in the run folder's sink the moment its gate decided: every gate a headless run resolved by its default, and step 1's tier override in any mode. The evidence report's Auto-Decisions table renders the same entries. Empty when there were none.

warnings.description: Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded in its run folder, one string each, such as customization_resolver_unavailable. Empty when none.
